name: Standards Knowledge
description: Knowledge of the standards, regulations, and compliance frameworks relevant to the lab's work. Covers ISO/IEC 17025:2017 (lab competence), ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), Common Criteria (ISO/IEC 15408/18045), FIPS 140-3, digital forensic standards (ISO/IEC 27037/27041/27042/27043, UK Forensic Science Regulator Code of Practice), GDPR/privacy regulations, and the broader regulatory landscape affecting security testing and evaluation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to security standards or regulations

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Knows the major standards exist and their general purpose
evidence: Can name the key standards relevant to the lab (ISO 17025, 27001, CC, FIPS)
Understands that standards drive lab processes and engagement methodology

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Understands how standards apply to day-to-day work; follows standards-driven procedures
evidence: Follows lab procedures derived from ISO 17025 requirements
Understands the sections of relevant standards that affect their domain
Can explain how a specific standard requirement maps to a lab process

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Applies standards knowledge independently to engagements and evaluations
evidence: References appropriate standards in reports and assessments
Identifies when an engagement falls within or outside accreditation scope
Understands compliance requirements for client-facing deliverables

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Interprets standards for complex scenarios; contributes to compliance processes
evidence: Interprets standards requirements for non-obvious or complex scenarios
Contributes to internal audit preparation and gap analysis
Advises team on standards applicability for specific engagements

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Drives standards adoption; manages accreditation; participates in standards bodies
evidence: Leads or manages the lab's compliance with ISO 17025 or similar
Participates in standards body working groups or committees
Trains teams on standards and regulatory requirements

assessment_methods.description: Scenario: determine which standards and compliance requirements apply to a described engagement
Map a set of lab procedures to their originating standard requirements
